title: Future Vision
subtitle: Where the Kingdom's digital transformation is heading.
intro: Digital transformation in Saudi Arabia is guided by a national strategy that runs to 2030. This page looks at that roadmap, at how the Kingdom's international rankings have moved so far, and at what the Ministry of Interior's Public Security sector has announced for the next phase.

items.title: Digital Government Strategy 2023-2030
items.text: The national strategy sets out the Kingdom's aspirations, objectives, initiatives, and roadmap for digital government, aligned with Vision 2030. Its stated goal is that by 2030 the government provides world-class services that meet the needs of citizens effectively and efficiently.

items.title: From 800 Platforms to One Ecosystem
items.text: The strategy aims to consolidate more than 800 separate government platforms into one coherent ecosystem built around the user.

items.title: Participation and Inclusion
items.text: E-participation and digital inclusion are named among the strategy's priorities, with the aim that services are inclusive by default.

items.title: Announced Plans, Not Yet Delivered
items.text: Public Security has announced plans to extend the 911 system to every region, build AI-based police stations in Jeddah and the Eastern Province, and develop a broader Maidan application. A drone management system for security operations is under development. The Smart Security page shows the status of each item.
